model.title: A resolution designating August 7, 2026, as "National Lighthouse Day".

summary.text: The resolution sets August 7, 2026, as National Lighthouse Day. It encourages lighthouse grounds to be opened to the public where feasible, and it calls on Americans to mark the day with events that celebrate the country's maritime heritage, such as visiting historic lighthouse sites, supporting preservation efforts, and joining groups focused on lighthouse education and landmark preservation. It also restates the Senate's support for preserving and restoring historic lighthouses as lasting monuments to the nation's maritime history and the people who kept them operating.
